purpose: Preregistered validation of the WP24 sampler default (ExhaustionRule::AcceptUnlessDivergent applied to warmup transitions by Adaptation::DualAveraging and Adaptation::Paper, STUDIES/freeze_mode_v1) on the posteriordb_bench_v2 protocol: identical model set, gates, estimators, chains/iterations, competitor versions and settings; fresh seeds; the harness rebuilt against the current src/; arms reduced to owalnuts-da, owalnuts-stan-style, cmdstan, nutpie (the paper arm tracked DA at 0.995x in v2 and is dropped).

predecessor.artifacts_reused: none for measurement (summary.json read only for the v2-vs-v3 comparison table); the v2 compiled BridgeStan/CmdStan models, venv and posteriordb checkout no longer exist (their worktree was removed), so every model is compiled fresh with the same BridgeStan 2.9.0 / Stan 2.39.0 / CmdStan 2.39.0 toolchain and the same flags (no STAN_THREADS); the posteriordb checkout is a fresh shallow clone at commit 28f8d3d as in v2

kernel_under_test.api: owalnuts::sampler (Sampler, Init::uniform(), Tuning::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation); harness src/main.rs identical to v2 except the recorded warmup_exhaustion_rule field

sampler_default_under_test.applies_to: warmup (discarded) transitions of Adaptation::DualAveraging and Adaptation::Paper; retained transitions keep Tuning::kernel_options (Stop); Adaptation::Custom (the stan-style arm) is used as given, i.e. two-sided as in v2

owalnuts-da.target: owalnuts-bridgestan ReplicatedStanTarget, 4 replicas (BridgeStan 2.9.0, Stan 2.39.0, built WITHOUT STAN_THREADS, fresh compile for this study)

warmup.warmup_exhaustion_rule: AcceptUnlessDivergent (sampler default since WP24; v2 ran Stop)

owalnuts-da.starts: sampler::Init::uniform(): uniform(-2,2) unconstrained, redrawn up to 100 times until finite density and gradient; SmallRng(splitmix64(seed ^ INIT_SEED_TAG))

warmup.contents: mean-trajectory acceptance statistic, Stan initial step search, Stan metric regularisation, Stan restart reference mu = ln(10 h), delta = divergence threshold during the initial 75-transition phase
warmup.warmup_exhaustion_rule: as the preset (two-sided Stop; Adaptation::Custom is used as given) — identical to v2

nutpie.backend: bridgestan (nutpie.compile_stan_model; nutpie builds its own STAN_THREADS library)

run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-da, owalnuts-stan-style, cmdstan, nutpie; seeds ascending; strictly sequential
parameter_set: columns of the posteriordb reference draws; oWALNUTS draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain(include_tp=True)
estimators: arviz 0.23.4: rank rhat; bulk ESS; tail ESS prob (0.05, 0.95); mcse method mean

metrics.gradients_total: owalnuts target calls (start search + warmup + sampling, all chains); cmdstan sum n_leapfrog__ (warmup+sampling); nutpie sum n_steps (warmup+sampling)
metrics.wall: seconds around the single sampler call (Sampler::run, CmdStanModel.sample, nutpie.sample), warmup included, compile excluded; the oWALNUTS start search (a handful of evaluations) is outside the wall
metrics.wall_sampling_estimated: wall * gradients_sampling / gradients_total (all arms); cmdstan CSV elapsed times also recorded
metrics.ess_per_second: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / wall
metrics.ess_per_gradient: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / gradients_total; sampling-only variant also reported
metrics.agreement: z = (mean - mean_ref)/sqrt(mcse^2 + mcse_ref^2) with arviz mean MCSE on both sides; max |z| over parameters; flag if > 4
metrics.frozen_chain: an oWALNUTS chain with more than 500 of its 1,000 retained transitions ending in refinement exhaustion; a cell is frozen if any chain is

head_to_head: per (owalnuts arm, competitor): geometric mean over models with all seeds ok on both sides of the seed-median ratios of min bulk ESS/gradient, min bulk ESS/s and wall per gradient; wins counted per model; 'outright win' = gates passed >= competitor and higher seed-median ESS/gradient and ESS/s

predictions.P1: owalnuts-da passes all gates on >= 33 of 51 cells (v2: 32)
predictions.P2: owalnuts-da passes all gates on >= 2 of 3 arma11 seeds (v2: 0/3, all frozen; freeze_mode_v1 on the v2 seeds: 3/3)
predictions.P3: owalnuts-da geometric-mean min-bulk-ESS/gradient vs CmdStan >= 0.40 over all 17 models (v2: 0.233), and >= 0.45 over the 16 models excluding lotka_volterra (P3b; v2 post hoc excluding arma11 and lotka_volterra: 0.447)
predictions.P4: no model has owalnuts-da seed-median min-bulk-ESS/gradient below 0.8x its v2 value (seed noise; the rule only changes warmup where a leaf exhausts)
predictions.P5: owalnuts-da geometric-mean wall per gradient <= 1.0x CmdStan (v2: 0.771)

decision_rules: Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results. A driver crash is relaunched and the interrupted cell re-run from scratch (seeded), recorded as a deviation. No default changes from this study; it is the breadth confirmation named in the WP24 ledger entry, and the release gate for a breadth claim is P1, P3 and P5 together.
versus_v2: per model and arm (owalnuts-da, owalnuts-stan-style, cmdstan, nutpie): seed-median v3 / v2 ratios of min bulk ESS/gradient and ESS/s from v2 summary.json; geomean over models
